cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Fair Exchange
cards.instruction: Price every favor in time, effort, inconvenience, or future obligation.

mechanism: A confidently sets household exchange rates but negotiates the labor price down when B offers to reduce the actual pan work.
confusable: Unlike ordinary task allocation, each change receives a recalculated price; authority must concede terms to keep B cooperating.
comparison: A cheese-pan soaking discount differs from a move exchanged for professional painting and stair effort.
seedUse: Use D46-a pan/cheese/soak rate chain and S02-a adopting a changed rate as intended negotiation.
